best_hook.why: A noblewoman reveals that the woman kneeling in the mud helped poison her and orders her cast into the road: a reveal and a punishment in one line.

best_cliffhanger.why: A clean ultimatum (take the apron or leave the county) cut before the humiliated villain decides.

must_promos.why: The Duke orders the scheming impostor thrown out, she screams for mercy in the mud, and the healer wife stops him only to make her a scullery maid. It ends on the take-it-or-leave ultimatum, before Catherine chooses.
A punchier cut: the poison accusation, the order to throw her out, 'Stop.', the apparent mercy, then the twist 'As a scullery maid.' lands and the clip cuts on her shock.

standalone_risk: A stranger gets only hints of what Catherine did (impostor bride, aided a poisoning). The clip does not show that she is secretly scheming to stay, so her submission can read as a resolved ending.
notes: Scene 1 (Catherine plotting with a conspirator) and Scene 2 (the bedroom reassurance) are weak. All the promo value is in the courtyard and hall humiliation.
